protocol.centre_selection: Lowest acquired regularized objective among final and independent truth-start candidates after both pass local and unchanged multistart/bound checks.
protocol.covariance: Gauss-Newton inverse precision J.T J / sigma^2 + prior precision; conditional density block versus all 50 parameters.
protocol.interval: Pointwise empirical 2.5/97.5 percentiles; same 1024 iid normal draws for linear/nonlinear propagation within each model.
protocol.evaluation: 2048 fixed scrambled Sobol volume points in [-1,1]^2 x [-.16,.16]; foreground truth >= 5% of queried truth maximum. Projection query uses original z[::2],detector[::4], all original angles; acquired and withheld metrics separate. Latent clean projection intervals only.
protocol.bounds: Untruncated Gaussian diagnostic: retain all samples, never clip/reject; report per-parameter and any-bound violation fractions; flag >1% any-bound violations as approximation concern without removing cases.
protocol.monte_carlo: Compare metrics from first and second 512 samples; density linear/nonlinear must agree to roundoff.
limitations: One mode local Gaussian approximation, not exact posterior sampling.
Truth-based geometry prior and matched model; report noisy 23/24 and clean 8/8 eligibility separately.
Only three noise draws per configuration; correlated query points are not independent trials.
Coverage and width must be reported together with error and bound diagnostics.
Numerical eligibility does not certify covariance validity, unimodality or calibration.
